name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section VIII – European Ombudsman
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Ombudsman spent its 2023 budget of about 13.2 million euros. The Ombudsman handles citizens' complaints about poor administration by European Union bodies. Parliament notes the office handled more complaints and inquiries than before, kept spending under control, and had no major problems found by the European Court of Auditors. Parliament also asks for improvements: faster handling of access-to-documents delays by the European Commission, a shorter vacancy for the Secretary-General post, and clearer rules on conflicts of interest for senior staff.

- Parliament formally approves the Ombudsman's 2023 spending; no money changes hands.
- The Ombudsman must report back on risk management, ethics rules and data protection actions.
- Parliament urges the European Commission to speed up replies to requests for documents.
